# Mandrell's CFO Services

> Fractional CFO and a full outsourced accounting department — Gainesville, Florida.

**What:** Fractional CFO services, outsourced accounting department, controller services, cash-flow forecasting and financial reporting for businesses from start-up to $30M in revenue. Family-owned, founded 2018.

**Where:** 235 South Main St, Suite W201, Gainesville, FL 32601 — serving Florida and the Southeast.

**Who it's for:** Owner-operated businesses that have outgrown a bookkeeper but aren't ready for a full-time CFO.

**Cost:** Monthly engagements scoped after a ten-minute intake.

**Contact:** Call (352) 248-0518, email cfo@mandrells.com, or begin the intake at https://mandrellscfo.ericolsen.studio/intake.html
